title: After the session; Lester Young's sound
summary: He describes the quiet elevator ride and how Lester's sound differed from Coleman Hawkins and other New York tenors.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Yes. And we were just coming -- it was a big thing when the tape finished, and I guess it's because we were excited talking about that session --
-- which you said, really, was one of the biggest thrills of your life.
Well, after that session, I mean -- do you remember -- did you guys -- did everybody walk out together? Can you remember anything about it? I mean, you didn't just all break up did you?
Yeah -- well, we talked after the session, more or less --
-- and we came downstairs on the elevator together.
But, we didn't have too much to say to each other, you know.
Yeah. Everybody went their own way, you know.
You know, nobody had much to say.
Did Lester appeal to you right away? His way, and his self? Or did you not quite dig him at first?
I don't remember what feeling, you know?
I just wondered if you did.
No, I don't remember what feeling -- the impression you know.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, there was too much going on for you.
I was just so happy to, you know, see everybody, you know.
Did you -- I think what you're coming back to now is not only the style, but the sound.
Well, I was even thinking about the person --
Because Lester, you know, I mean, you know he was --
Well, sound wise, it was different -- you know, it was different from what I was used to hearing around New York, see?
Well, it wasn't even sound -- it was the rhythmic thing.
I mean that was the thing that he and Billie recognized in each other. They were sort of into another world there.
I knew it was a different -- you know, in sound.
You see, as far as Lester's concerned --
-- and what had been happening back east here.
Yes. That's right. Or anywhere, Freddie, really, I think. You know?
And, at this first session, or meeting, Freddie would have -- you can't expect Freddie to sort of dig Lester's personality. I mean, they were all more or less strangers.
Yeah, that's true. But, Lester was so different, wasn't he Freddie?
But, he's so quiet, or course, he was so quiet you might not notice.
Yeah, he was quiet. Like, as far as a person, more or less, you know -- the first meeting -- I never --
I don't think we were, one way or the other, you know what I mean
But, as far as the sound was concerned -- I knew it was different.
And, I don't remember whether I took to it right away, or not.
